evidence: Petr. 119.41: vēnālis populus, vēnālis cūria patrum
terms.comment: Literally “the people is for sale, the senate house of the fathers is for sale”: a line of the poem on the civil war in Petronius, of the bought votes of Rome. The line was read in the Perseus text; it is not in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Petronius 119.41, read in the Perseus Latin texts (12 November 2026).
